chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb or Ibn 'Ammar from al-Subbah ibn Siyabah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Do not leave the Adhan in all the prayers. If you leave it, do not leave it in Maghrib and Fajr, for there is no shortening (in their rak'ahs) in them.'
ai.seo_question: Why is the Adhan emphasized in Maghrib and Fajr prayers?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the Adhan as a consistent Sunnah across all prayers, yet highlights its critical role in Maghrib and Fajr where the full four-rak'ah structure is maintained without shortening. This distinction underscores the theological weight of public proclamation during the transition of day and night, reinforcing the communal identity of the Shia faithful in maintaining ritual visibility even when individual circumstances permit omission.
